pr_title: fix(rust): Add serialization support for newer data types
pr_body: Add (De)serialization support for Null, Decimal, Array Datatypes

issue_context.title: Serialization is not implemented for Null dtype series
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
import pickle

import polars as pl

t = pl.DataFrame({"a": None}, schema={"a":pl.Null})
pickle.dumps(t)
```


### Issue description

Series with Null dtype does not support serialization. Result of MRE is:

```python
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at 'not implemented', /home/runner/work/polars/polars/crates/polars-core/src/serde/series.rs:66:17
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```

### Expected behavior

Successful serialization
